items.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic food photography of a traditional dish presented on a rustic wooden table. Finished dish placed in the foreground grape-leaf rolls soup with meatballs with steam rising naturally. Ingredients floating above the dish in a clean, organized layout fresh herbs, rice, minced meat, onion, spices, olive oil, potato, chickpeas, saffron each ingredient isolated and clearly visible. Subtle curved infographic lines and minimal labels pointing to each ingredient. Warm studio lighting with soft shadows, shallow depth of field, earthy color palette, premium cookbook and food-education style. Hyper-detailed textures, realistic food surfaces, editorial culinary infographic, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, 8K quality.
